# hypbr

> Hybrid Neural + Exact Periodic Procedural PBR Material Synthesizer that outputs seamlessly tileable, physically calibrated 15-map PBR texture sets (glTF 2.0 ORM, 16-bit height, OpenGL/DirectX tangent normals, 8-azimuth HBAO, bent normals, curvature, anisotropy, specular, and thickness).

## Install

- `pip install -e .` (core procedural synthesis: `numpy`, `pillow`, `torch`)
- `pip install -e ".[neural]"` (optional photo-to-PBR via ONNX Runtime + Apple Depth Pro)

## CLI Commands

- `hypbr list` — List built-in seamless procedural material IDs and categories.
- `hypbr synth <material_id|hardops_plate|all> --size 512 --out ./output/pbr [--seed 42] [--export unity,godot,unreal,blender,threejs,gltf,vulkan,materialx|all]` — Synthesize a complete 15-map seamless PBR material set and optionally export to target engines.
- `hypbr export <src_dir> --target <unity|unity-hdrp|godot|unreal|blender|threejs|gltf|vulkan|materialx|all> --out <out_dir>` — Export an existing `hypbr` material directory with engine-native channel packing, normal convention, and material definition files.
- `hypbr dump-preset [v13-default]` — Export a built-in composable PBR node graph preset as JSON.
- `hypbr photo <image> --preset v13-default [--graph custom.json] [--tileable] [--dx] --out ./output/photo_pbr` — Convert a macro photograph into 15 PBR maps using Apple Depth Pro + DeepBump ONNX + the 47-node graph.

## Python API

- `from hypbr import list_materials, synthesize_material, synthesize_all, synthesize_hardops_plate, export_material, SUPPORTED_TARGETS, PRESETS, run_graph`
- `export_material(src_dir, out_dir, target, name=None) -> Path`: Converts a synthesized `hypbr` directory to engine-native assets:
  - `unity`: URP `MetallicSmoothness.png` (`R=Metallic, A=1-Roughness`), OpenGL `+Y` normal, `unity_material.json`.
  - `unity-hdrp`: HDRP `MaskMap.png` (`R=Metallic, G=AO, B=Detail, A=1-Roughness`), OpenGL `+Y` normal.
  - `godot`: Godot 4 `material.tres` (`StandardMaterial3D` with ORM channels + deep parallax) + textures.
  - `unreal`: DirectX `-Y` flipped `T_Normal_DX.png` & `T_BentNormal_DX.png`, `T_ORM.png`, `T_Height16.png`, `ue5_material.json`.
  - `blender`: Blender 4.x `import_blender.py` (Principled BSDF node tree with `sRGB`/`Non-Color` setup) + textures.
  - `threejs`: ES module `material.js` (`MeshPhysicalMaterial` factory) + textures.
  - `gltf`: glTF 2.0 `material.gltf` + `baseColor.png`, `orm.png`, `normal.png`.
  - `vulkan`: `vulkan_manifest.json` (`VK_FORMAT_*` + `ktx create` commands), `orm_unorm.png`, `normal_rg_bc5_src.png`, `height_r16.png`.
  - `materialx`: MaterialX 1.38 `material.mtlx` (`standard_surface` + `displacement`) + textures.
- `list_materials() -> list[dict[str, str]]`: Returns `{id, description, category}` entries for all built-in procedural materials.
- `synthesize_material(material_id: str, out_dir: Path | str, size: int = 512, seed: int | None = None) -> Path`: Writes 15 seamless PBR PNGs + `preview.png` to `out_dir`.
- `synthesize_all(out_dir: Path | str, size: int = 512, materials: list[str] | None = None) -> list[Path]`: Batch-synthesizes all or selected materials.
- `synthesize_hardops_plate(out_dir: Path, size: int = 512) -> Path`: Synthesizes a machined hard-surface gunmetal panel using SDF plugs, bevels, and weld fillets.
- `PRESETS: dict[str, dict]`: Built-in JSON-serializable PBR node graphs (default: `"v13-default"`).

## Output Maps (per material)

- `albedo_delit.png`: 8-bit sRGB de-lit base color
- `normal.png`: 8-bit RGB tangent-space normal (OpenGL +Y; pass `--dx` in `photo` mode for DirectX -Y)
- `bent_normal.png`: 8-bit RGB average unoccluded hemisphere direction
- `height.png`, `height16.png`: 8-bit and 16-bit linear POM/displacement heightmaps
- `ao.png`: 8-bit 8-azimuth Horizon-Based Ambient Occlusion
- `roughness.png`: 8-bit roughness with Kaplanyan/Toksvig Specular AA
- `metallic.png`: 8-bit metallic mask
- `orm.png`: 8-bit glTF 2.0 packed ORM (`R=AO, G=Roughness, B=Metallic`)
- `curvature.png`, `cavity.png`, `edge_wear.png`: Multi-scale curvature, crevice, and convex wear masks
- `anisotropy.png`, `specular.png`, `thickness.png`: Anisotropic tangent flow, F0 specular modulation, subsurface thickness
- `preview.png`: Shaded studio preview

## Core Modules

- [hypbr/exporters.py](hypbr/exporters.py): Engine & standard I/O exporters (`unity`, `unity-hdrp`, `godot`, `unreal`, `blender`, `threejs`, `gltf`, `vulkan`, `materialx`).
- [hypbr/cli.py](hypbr/cli.py): Command-line entrypoint (`hypbr`).
- [hypbr/synthesize.py](hypbr/synthesize.py): Public Python synthesis API and multi-tone physical albedo/metallic rules.
- [hypbr/procedural.py](hypbr/procedural.py): Exact periodic FBM, Voronoi, weave, ceramic, wood, and metal heightfield generators.
- [hypbr/normal_graph.py](hypbr/normal_graph.py): 47-node composable PBR graph engine (RNM blending, Weickert structure tensor, analytic bevels, 8-azimuth HBAO, Specular AA).
- [hypbr/depthpro_pbr.py](hypbr/depthpro_pbr.py): Optional Apple Depth Pro + DeepBump ONNX neural relief extractor with 4-rotation perspective cancellation.

## Examples & Tests

- [examples/synthesize_pbr.py](examples/synthesize_pbr.py): Synthesize sample 15-map PBR materials via Python API.
- [examples/custom_graph.py](examples/custom_graph.py): Inspect and export an editable 47-node JSON graph.
- [tests/test_smoke.py](tests/test_smoke.py): Smoke tests verifying catalog, presets, and 15-map output integrity.
